name: gldt-monorepo
description: GLDT frontend app and GLDT canister
author: GoldDAO

scripts.build: pnpm run build:backdid && pnpm run build:back
scripts.build:back: scripts/build_canister.sh gldt_swap && scripts/build_canister.sh icp_neuron && scripts/build_canister.sh sns_rewards
scripts.build:backdid: scripts/build_canister.sh --wasmonly gldt_swap && scripts/build_canister.sh --wasmonly sns_rewards && pnpm run build:candid && pnpm run build:declarations && pnpm run build:back
scripts.start: dfx stop && dfx start --background --clean && pnpm run deploy
scripts.test: pnpm run build:backdid && cargo tarpaulin --count -o html
scripts.postinstall: rustup update; rustup component add clippy; echo 'If installing locally, you should also ensure that ic-wasm is installed (cargo install ic-wasm), as well as wasmtime (see https://wasmtime.dev ).'
scripts.clean:client: rm -rf client/*/pnpm-lock.yaml client/*/node_modules client/*/.next client/*/dist client/*/next-env.d.ts .pnpm-store
